purpose: Review references 60–62 and 68–90 from the generated reference inventory. This dated proposal does not edit research/reviews.json, accept claims, or convert historical operator reports into current vendor guidance.
scope: Three pinned upstream project files and 23 historical Cisco VoIP or VoiceOps mailing-list sources. Five jurisdiction observations at indices 63–67 are handled by the separate jurisdictions-2026-11-04 proposal.

references.historicalClaim: The pinned upstream architecture describes a static browser page assembled from ordered source files into a classic script, with shared state and separated game layers. The proposed requirement is to retain useful shell, canvas, panel, persistence and test patterns while giving expanded domains clear function boundaries.
references.historicalSourceDate: Pinned upstream commit 48e6200c532d486f79bc8376de0aecbf6169123b; archive snapshot recorded in maintenance/upstream/observations/2026-11-03-v260.
references.currentFinding: The exact pinned docs/ARCHITECTURE.md was successfully retrieved through the connected GitHub file tool at commit 48e6200c532d486f79bc8376de0aecbf6169123b. The earlier web-tool and raw URL attempts returned Cache miss; those failures are retained in checkedSources. The pinned document confirms a static page assembled from ordered src files into one classic HTML page, with shared top-level script scope, a canvas/map layer, panel/UI layers, and an in-memory jsdom harness. It supports those architecture observations, but not every proposed behavior as an upstream guarantee.

references.historicalClaim: The pinned save implementation writes the game state under `sot-save-v1`, wraps exported files with app/version metadata, and validates imported state. The design claim additionally asks the fork to isolate its identifiers and retain applicable license/attribution notices.
references.historicalSourceDate: Pinned upstream commit 48e6200c532d486f79bc8376de0aecbf6169123b; archive snapshot recorded 2026-11-03.
references.currentFinding: The exact pinned `src/game/91-save.js` was successfully retrieved through the connected GitHub file tool at commit 48e6200c532d486f79bc8376de0aecbf6169123b. This file writes one `sot-save-v1` localStorage key, supports gzip storage for large saves, exports an object with `app: series-of-tubes` and `version`, and accepts `v===1` save data with basic day/cash/pops/links validation. Migration and sanitize are referenced as upstream functions elsewhere; this file does not establish an ISP-specific field inventory, slot scheme, version-stamped cache, or license terms. Earlier web and raw URL attempts returned Cache miss and are retained below.

limitations: Earlier web/raw requests for the pinned upstream files returned Cache miss. The connected GitHub tool subsequently retrieved the exact architecture, save and harness files; findings use those files and retain the initial access history. No claim of a deleted or dead page is made.
